description: Source code for ResourceManager plugin handling AV blocking, TTS resource reservation, and related functionalities within the WPEFramework. Implements JSON-RPC methods, manages internal state, and interacts with external components like EssRMgr.

classes.name: JSONRPCDirectLink
classes.description: Helper class for making JSON-RPC calls to other services within the framework.

classes.name: ResourceManager
classes.description: Main class implementing resource management functionalities, including AV blocking and TTS resource reservation.

methods.name: setAVBlockedWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for setting AV blocked status for an application via JSON-RPC.

methods.name: getBlockedAVApplicationsWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for retrieving list of applications with AV blocked status.

methods.name: reserveTTSResourceWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for reserving TTS resource for an application.

methods.name: setAVBlocked
methods.description: Sets AV blocked status for a given callsign, interacts with EssRMgr if enabled.

methods.name: getBlockedAVApplications
methods.description: Retrieves list of applications currently blocked from AV.

methods.name: reserveTTSResource
methods.description: Reserves TTS resource for a specified client application.
